privacy.metaDescription: How Menuyukti collects, uses, and protects data in your workspace.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

data.title: Data we process
data.body: Menuyukti processes information you provide when you use the product—including account details, location and sales data you upload, workflow and milestone content, and usage needed to run the service. We process this data to deliver analytics, workflows, and AI-assisted features you request.

use.title: How we use your data
use.body: We use your data to operate and improve the platform, provide support, secure accounts, and comply with law. We do not sell your personal information or your restaurant sales data to third parties for their marketing.

sharing.title: Service providers
sharing.body: We may use trusted subprocessors (for example hosting, authentication, and AI inference) that process data under contract and only as needed to provide the service. A current list can be provided on request.

security.title: Security
security.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; we encourage strong passwords and safe sharing of workspace access.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: Menuyukti uses Google Analytics 4 for basic usage measurement (page views) on public pages and the signed-in workspace so we can understand how the product is used. The print shop is not included. You can review or dismiss the cookie notice via the Cookie settings link in the footer.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy-related questions or requests, contact us through the same channel you use for Menuyukti product support.

terms.metaDescription: Terms governing use of the Menuyukti platform.
terms.title: Terms of Service

service.title: The service
service.body: Menuyukti provides software for restaurant marketing workflows, analytics, and related AI-assisted features. Features may change as the product evolves.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping credentials secure. You agree to provide accurate information and to use the service in compliance with applicable law.

acceptable.title: Acceptable use
acceptable.body: You may not misuse the service, attempt to access others’ data without permission, interfere with operation of the platform, or use the service to violate law or third-party rights.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: The service and any AI-generated outputs are provided on an “as is” basis. Analytics and suggestions are informational; you remain responsible for business and compliance decisions.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms or the service. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms where permitted by law.
